ui_interface_text_setting.section_intro: Choose how text and colors should appear across the app.
ui_interface_text_setting.current_setup_intro: The whole interface updates from these settings.
ui_interface_text_setting.display_modes_intro: Quick reference for each language display mode.

display_modes.title: English
display_modes.body: Keeps menu names, page titles, and descriptions fully in English.

display_modes.title: Thai
display_modes.body: Switches menu names, page titles, and descriptions to Thai.

display_modes.title: Mixed
display_modes.body: Keeps English titles while showing Thai descriptions.

ui_interface_text_setting.themes_intro: Quick reference for the available color directions.

themes.title: Cocoa Brown
themes.body: Rich cocoa neutrals with vanilla-cream panels and warm contrast.

themes.title: Mystic Violet
themes.body: A dreamy violet palette with cooler glass panels.

themes.title: Cotton Candy Cloud
themes.body: A light pink-and-blue palette with a softer candy atmosphere.

themes.title: Lunar Cloud
themes.body: Pure white cards on a soft gray canvas with charcoal navigation.

error_messages.invalid_menu_config: The menu ordering data is invalid. Please refresh the page and try again.
error_messages.missing_menu_group: The menu ordering is incomplete. Please refresh the page and try again.
error_messages.duplicate_menu_group: The menu ordering contains a duplicated menu group.
error_messages.invalid_menu_items: The menu ordering contains unexpected menu items.
error_messages.duplicate_menu_item: The menu ordering contains a duplicated menu item.

ui_interface_text_setting.menu_order_intro: Drag and drop to reorder menu blocks and items. Sub-menus cannot be moved between blocks.
